concepts.title: Shared direction
concepts.rationale: Two open channels form an S. The centre gap keeps each responsibility distinct while the whole mark reads as one coordinated effort.

concepts.title: Common ground
concepts.rationale: Two opposing voices share a central interval. The symbol foregrounds listening and dialogue, but reads less immediately as a name monogram.

concepts.title: Open knot
concepts.rationale: Paired folded shapes suggest alignment and continuity. Open corners retain the idea that records and responsibilities are never collapsed.

concepts.title: Records in concert
concepts.rationale: Three distinct vertical records share one baseline. Easy to reproduce, but its resemblance to a chart makes it less distinctive as the primary identity.

concepts.title: Assembly
concepts.rationale: Four separate participants surround a shared plan. Strong at medium sizes, with the central square acting as coordination rather than an owner.

concepts.title: Next step
concepts.rationale: Two separate routes form a reciprocal journey. It expresses follow-through clearly, but arrows are more literal and less ownable than the S monogram.
